purpose: 真实 socketpair + 冻结 R11 AuthorityClient 的 O_NONBLOCK 交接复现

withoutConversion.setup: accepted 侧 fd 保持 O_NONBLOCK；请求后延迟 150ms 才写 response
withoutConversion.result: ok=0 error=authority channel closed before response close_reason=authority-read-error: Resource temporarily unavailable

withConversion.setup: 交接前仅清除 file-status O_NONBLOCK，保留其余 flags；同一延迟 response
